currentRoundInspection.scope: Two useful pictures and normal viewer PMTiles/DEM. Older record had no exact map control; current named polygon/court establishes approximate fit. No bespoke sources or redistributed photographs.

pictures.author: Sherief1969
pictures.observed: Inspected complete 960×640 courtyard view. Pale marble court, open pointed arcades on slender pale columns, broad dark roof soffits, triangular/stepped merlons and central octagonal ablution canopy on eight columns. Canopy has brown timber soffit/edge gallery, pale dome and small finial over a low basin. Fine capitals, medallions, inscriptions, tap furniture and exact railing pattern not copied.

pictures.author: Mohammed Basha
pictures.observed: Inspected complete 960×640 exterior. Low light-cream facade with repeated round upper arched niches and warm stone arch surrounds, sparse pointed ground entrances, roofline merlons and two slender corner minarets with projecting balcony, tapering upper stage and pale pointed cap. Palms obscure part of the near tower. Fence, street furniture, garden and exact calligraphy/fine ornament remain host content or omitted.
